app.name: CleanYourPhone
app.tagline: A guided cleanup for your Android phone
app.local_only: Local only. No account, no cloud, no telemetry.
welcome.title: Connect your phone
welcome.body: Disable preinstalled apps with a short, reversible flow. No root, no account, and undo is always available.
welcome.hint: If something does not match, nothing is changed and you can undo.
setup.title: Android Platform-Tools
setup.body: Android Platform-Tools includes ADB, the tool this app uses to talk to your phone. Google requires a separate download.
setup.terms: Downloading means you accept Google's Android SDK terms.
setup.consent: I accept Google's Android SDK terms.
setup.offline: If you are offline, close the app and come back later.
setup.invalid_adb: That file is not a valid ADB or is older than version 31.0.0.
setup.download_failed: Platform-Tools could not be downloaded. Nothing has been changed.
setup.hash_failed: The download did not pass the safety check. Nothing has been installed.
setup.download_cancelled: Download cancelled. Nothing has been installed.
connect.title: Connect your phone
connect.body: Choose Wi-Fi for Android 11 or newer, or use a USB cable.
connect.wifi_steps:
1. On the phone, open Developer options > Wireless debugging.
2. Tap Pair device with pairing code.
3. Enter the six-digit code and the IP:port address here.
connect.invalid_code: The pairing code must be six digits.
connect.invalid_address: Enter the IP:port address shown on the phone.
connect.adb_missing: ADB is not ready. Go back and finish the ADB setup.
connect.usb_steps:
1. On the phone, turn on Developer options.
2. Turn on USB debugging.
3. Connect the cable and accept the prompt on the phone.
connect.multiple_devices: More than one device is connected. Choose your phone by model and connection.
connect.failed: The phone could not be connected. Nothing has been changed.
connect.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Check that the pairing code matches the one on the phone and that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network.
connect.connection_failed: The phone could not be reached over Wi-Fi. Keep Wireless debugging on and try again.
connect.no_devices: No phone was found. Check the cable or the Wi-Fi connection and try again.
check.title: Checking your phone
check.body: The app checks the model, Android version, build and roles before changing anything.
check.failed: The phone could not be checked. Nothing has been changed.
blocked.title: This phone is not a tested case
blocked.body: The app stops before changing anything when the phone is not in the tested list.
blocked.no_profile: We do not have a tested profile for this phone and this version. Nothing has been changed.
blocked.untested_build: The profile exists, but this build is not tested. Nothing has been changed.
blocked.managed: This phone is managed by a company. The app cannot change packages.
blocked.managed_unknown: The app could not tell whether this phone is managed by a company. The app cannot change packages.
blocked.users_unknown: The app could not tell how many users this phone has. The app cannot change packages.
blocked.multi_user: This phone has more than one user. The app cannot change packages.
blocked.old_android: This phone uses Android 7 or older. The app needs Android 8 or newer.
blocked.tv: This device is a TV, not a phone. The app cannot continue.
blocked.role_check: The phone, SMS, Home or keyboard app could not be checked. Nothing has been changed.
backup.title: Backing up your phone
backup.body: A copy of the package list is created so you can undo. The app does not continue without a backup.
backup.failed: The backup could not be created. Nothing has been changed.
backup.no_skip: There is no option to skip the backup.
review.title: Review what will be disabled
review.body: Check the apps that will be disabled, why they are listed and what can stop working.
review.ask_note: Check only the apps you want to disable. The rest are left as they are.
review.plan_failed: The package list could not be loaded. Nothing has been changed.
review.plan_changed: The package list changed and this selection is no longer safe. Nothing has been changed.
review.empty_selection: Choose at least one app to continue.
ads.body: Optional. Use a private DNS to block ads and trackers on this phone.
ads.caveat: Blocks many ads and trackers, but not YouTube ads.
apply.title: Applying the changes
apply.body: Apps are disabled in batches of five. The phone is checked after every batch.
apply.empty_selection: Choose at least one app in Review to continue.
apply.not_ready: Cannot apply without a backup, a profile and a selection. Nothing has been changed.
apply.plan_changed: The package list changed and the batch stopped. Check the packages that are still disabled.
apply.state_unknown: The app could not confirm which packages are still disabled. Check the phone and use Undo everything if anything changed.
apply.rollback_verified: The batch failed, but the check found no packages from this selection still disabled.
apply.stopping: The app will stop after this batch.
apply.failed: A batch failed. The app stopped and checked the phone.
apply.failed_batch: The batch tried to roll back. We checked the phone; these packages are still disabled:
apply.do_not_close: Do not close the window while a batch is being applied.
done.title: Done
done.body: Review the result and keep the backup and the undo option.
done.ads_offline: Ad blocking could not be checked: the phone appears to be offline.
done.ads_check_failed: Ad blocking could not be checked.
done.ads_set_failed: Ad blocking could not be enabled. The apps remain disabled.
done.ads_unconfirmed: Ad blocking could not be confirmed.
done.verified: The phone was checked after the changes.
done.failed: A batch failed and the phone may be partially changed. Check the packages that are still disabled and use Undo everything.
done.stopped: You stopped after {count} apps. The remaining packages were not changed.
done.undo_body: Undo restores every CleanYourPhone change recorded for this phone, including changes from older sessions.
done.undo_unavailable: There is no backup available to undo.
done.dry_run_failed: The undo summary could not be prepared. Undo was not started; the phone was not changed by undo.
done.undo_failed: Undo could not be completed from this phone's journal. The app did not retry automatically.
done.undone: Undone. Every change recorded for this phone was restored.
done.restore_failed: The backup could not be restored.
done.fallback_warning: Restoring from the backup rebuilds the state from the backup, not from the phone's journal. It may enable apps that were not part of this session. Use it only when this phone's journal is unavailable.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The app stopped so the phone is not left half changed.
settings.title: Settings
logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Logs stay on this computer. Serials, codes, IP addresses and package names are hidden.
